name: metabase-to-sigma
description: Migrate Metabase to Sigma — MBQL questions/models (+ database metadata) → Sigma data model, and dashboards → Sigma workbooks. Translates MBQL expressions/aggregations (case→If, count-where→CountIf, datetime-* → Date*) and flags what it can't (cum-sum/offset windows, segment refs, funnel/gauge viz, click behaviors). Includes a read-only estate assessment. Built from public Metabase docs — pending first live validation. Companion to the sigma-migration-skills converters.
